title: Node.js — Run JavaScript Everywhere
key_points: Node.js® is a free, open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment that lets developers create servers, web apps, command line tools and scripts.
Learn more what Node.js is able to offer with our Learning materials.
asserts: Node.js® is a free, open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment that lets developers create servers, web apps, command line tools and scripts.
